definitions.explanation: A preliminary version of a document, plan, or law that is subject to revision. Commonly used in legal, political, and business contexts. Composed of 草 (grass/rough) + 案 (plan/idea).

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草案|そうあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A draft of the bill was submitted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{草案|そうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: The committee will review the draft.

examples.japanese: ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草案|そうあん}をめぐって⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交|か}わされた→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: Heated debate was exchanged over the draft constitutional amendment.

notes:
USAGE:
{草案|そうあん} is a formal word most commonly used in political, legal, and bureaucratic contexts. It implies a document that is still subject to review and revision before being finalized.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {草案|そうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧ (prepare a draft)
- {草案|そうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (submit a draft)
- {草案|そうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧ (review a draft)
- {草案|そうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧ (put together a draft)
- ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧{草案|そうあん} (constitutional draft)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{下書|したが}き→下書き：06836_shitagaki⟧ means "rough draft" and is used more generally for any written draft. ⟦{原案|げんあん}→原案：11978_genan⟧ means "original plan" or "original draft" and suggests the first version of a proposal. ⟦{素案|そあん}→素案：22971_soan⟧ is a very preliminary draft or outline.
